title: Exact quantum time compatible with positive energy
summary: What would it be like to be in a superposition of yesterday, today, and tomorrow? This question may seem at best entertaining, but it is necessary, and exploring it allows us to understand how exact irreversible clocks and change are possible, despite the Unruh-Wald and Hegerfeldt-Ruijsenaars no-go theorems forbidding them. Unruh and Wald (1989) proved that if energy is bounded from below, no observable can increase monotonically with the Schrödinger time parameter t.
